title: Password Reset Flow

requirements.text: Add a 'Forgot password?' link and a form on the login page to request a reset by entering the account email
Generate a single-use, time-limited reset token and email a reset link to the registered address
Provide a reset form that validates the token and rejects expired, used, or invalid tokens before accepting a new password
Hash and store the new password using the existing password-hashing scheme on successful reset
Invalidate the user's existing sessions after a successful reset

hallucination_traps: No SMS-based reset or two-factor authentication is mentioned
notes: A faithful decomposition covers the forgot-password entry point, emailed single-use token, reset form with token validation, password update, and session invalidation; must not invent SMS/2FA recovery.
